import Research.Projects.BinaryTreeReduction.Reduction

/-!
# Componentwise backward error for a rounded tree dot product

Each pair at a leaf contributes one rounded multiplication. Internal nodes
then use the supplied rounded addition reduction. The error bound counts that
multiplication and at most `tree.depth` additions on each leaf-to-root path.
-/

namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction

open Research.FloatingPoint

/-- Exact componentwise products, retaining the input tree's binary shape. -/
def exactProductTree (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
  tree.map (fun pair => pair.1 * pair.2)

/-- Round every componentwise product under the given relative-error model. -/
def roundedProductTree (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
  tree.map (fun pair => model.mul pair.1 pair.2)

/-- Compute rounded products and reduce them with rounded tree addition. -/
def roundedDotProduct (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : ℝ :=
  roundedSum model (roundedProductTree model tree)

@[simp] theorem exactProductTree_depth (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (exactProductTree tree).depth = tree.depth := by
  simp [exactProductTree]

@[simp] theorem roundedProductTree_depth (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (roundedProductTree model tree).depth = tree.depth := by
  simp [roundedProductTree]

/-- For every model and binary tree, the rounded dot product is the exact sum
of leafwise perturbations of the exact products. The bound includes one
multiplication rounding and all addition roundings along each leaf's path.
No exact-arithmetic assumption is imposed on the model. -/
theorem roundedDotProduct_exists_perturbation
    (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hsmall : ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
      IsPerturbation (gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u)
        (exactProductTree tree) perturbed ∧
      perturbed.exactSum = roundedDotProduct model tree := by
  sorry

end Research.BinaryTreeReduction
import Mathlib

/-!
# Abstract floating-point model

This is the standard relative-error model used by the binary-tree project,
not a bit-level formalization of IEEE 754.
-/

namespace Research.FloatingPoint

/-- A rounding operation satisfying the standard relative-error model.
The specification covers operations for which overflow and underflow do not occur.
-/
structure Model where
  u : ℝ
  u_nonneg : 0 ≤ u
  round : ℝ → ℝ
  round_spec : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ u ∧ round z = z * (1 + δ)

/-- Floating-point addition induced by an abstract rounding model. -/
def Model.add (model : Model) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  model.round (a + b)

/-- Floating-point multiplication induced by an abstract rounding model. -/
def Model.mul (model : Model) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  model.round (a * b)

end Research.FloatingPoint
import Research.Common.FloatingPoint.Model

/-! # Accumulated relative error -/

namespace Research.FloatingPoint

/-- Standard bound for `k` accumulated relative errors of size at most `u`. -/
noncomputable def gamma (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)

@[simp] theorem gamma_zero (u : ℝ) : gamma 0 u = 0 := by
  simp [gamma]

/-- The product of the relative-error factors in a list. -/
def errorProduct (errors : List ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (errors.map fun δ => 1 + δ).prod

@[simp] theorem errorProduct_nil : errorProduct [] = 1 := by
  simp [errorProduct]

@[simp] theorem errorProduct_cons (δ : ℝ) (errors : List ℝ) :
    errorProduct (δ :: errors) = (1 + δ) * errorProduct errors := by
  simp [errorProduct]

/-- `gamma` is nonnegative whenever its denominator is positive. -/
theorem gamma_nonneg (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hsmall : (k : ℝ) * u < 1) :
    0 ≤ gamma k u := by
  unfold gamma
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hu) (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hsmall))

/-- The algebraic step used when one more rounding-error factor is added. -/
theorem gamma_step (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hsmall : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u < 1) :
    gamma k u + u * (1 + gamma k u) ≤ gamma (k + 1) u := by
  have hk_nonneg : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk_small : (k : ℝ) * u < 1 := by
    norm_num at hsmall ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hk_denom : 0 < 1 - (k : ℝ) * u := sub_pos.mpr hk_small
  have hsucc_denom : 0 < 1 - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u := sub_pos.mpr hsmall
  rw [gamma, gamma]
  norm_num at hsmall ⊢
  have hleft :
      (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u) +
          u * (1 + (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)) =
        ((k : ℝ) + 1) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hk_denom]
    ring
  rw [hleft]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
    (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hu)
    (by norm_num at hsucc_denom ⊢; exact hsucc_denom)
    (by nlinarith)

/-- A product of `k` relative-error factors differs from one by at most
`gamma k u`, provided each individual error is at most `u` and `k*u < 1`.
-/
theorem errorProduct_sub_one_abs_le_gamma (errors : List ℝ) (u : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hsmall : (errors.length : ℝ) * u < 1)
    (herrors : ∀ δ ∈ errors, |δ| ≤ u) :
    |errorProduct errors - 1| ≤ gamma errors.length u := by
  induction errors with
  | nil => simp
  | cons δ errors ih =>
      have hδ : |δ| ≤ u := herrors δ (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ ε ∈ errors, |ε| ≤ u := by
        intro ε hε
        exact herrors ε (by simp [hε])
      have htail_small : (errors.length : ℝ) * u < 1 := by
        norm_num at hsmall ⊢
        nlinarith
      have ih_bound := ih htail_small htail
      have hgamma_nonneg : 0 ≤ gamma errors.length u :=
        gamma_nonneg errors.length u hu htail_small
      have hproduct_abs : |errorProduct errors| ≤ 1 + gamma errors.length u := by
        calc
          |errorProduct errors| = |(errorProduct errors - 1) + 1| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |errorProduct errors - 1| + |(1 : ℝ)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ gamma errors.length u + 1 := by norm_num; linarith
          _ = 1 + gamma errors.length u := by ring
      calc
        |errorProduct (δ :: errors) - 1|
            = |(errorProduct errors - 1) + δ * errorProduct errors| := by
                rw [errorProduct_cons]
                congr 1
                ring
        _ ≤ |errorProduct errors - 1| + |δ * errorProduct errors| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |errorProduct errors - 1| + |δ| * |errorProduct errors| := by
              rw [abs_mul]
        _ ≤ gamma errors.length u + u * (1 + gamma errors.length u) := by
              gcongr
        _ ≤ gamma (errors.length + 1) u := gamma_step errors.length u hu (by
              norm_num at hsmall ⊢
              exact hsmall)
        _ = gamma (δ :: errors).length u := by simp

end Research.FloatingPoint
import Mathlib

/-! # Binary reduction trees -/

namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction

/-- A binary reduction tree with data stored at its leaves. -/
inductive Tree (α : Type*) where
  | leaf : α → Tree α
  | node : Tree α → Tree α → Tree α
  deriving Repr

namespace Tree

/-- Apply a function to every leaf while preserving the reduction shape. -/
def map (f : α → β) : Tree α → Tree β
  | leaf value => leaf (f value)
  | node left right => node (map f left) (map f right)

/-- Number of internal nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path. -/
def depth : Tree α → ℕ
  | leaf _ => 0
  | node left right => 1 + max left.depth right.depth

/-- Number of leaves in a tree. -/
def leafCount : Tree α → ℕ
  | leaf _ => 1
  | node left right => left.leafCount + right.leafCount

/-- Exact real-valued sum represented by a reduction tree. -/
def exactSum : Tree ℝ → ℝ
  | leaf value => value
  | node left right => left.exactSum + right.exactSum

/-- Multiply every leaf in a tree by the same scalar. -/
def scale (c : ℝ) : Tree ℝ → Tree ℝ
  | leaf value => leaf (c * value)
  | node left right => node (scale c left) (scale c right)

@[simp] theorem depth_leaf (x : α) : (leaf x).depth = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem leafCount_leaf (x : α) : (leaf x).leafCount = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem depth_map (f : α → β) (tree : Tree α) :
    (tree.map f).depth = tree.depth := by
  induction tree with
  | leaf value => rfl
  | node left right ihLeft ihRight => simp [map, depth, ihLeft, ihRight]

@[simp] theorem exactSum_leaf (x : ℝ) : (leaf x).exactSum = x := rfl

@[simp] theorem exactSum_node (left right : Tree ℝ) :
    (node left right).exactSum = left.exactSum + right.exactSum := rfl

@[simp] theorem exactSum_scale (c : ℝ) (tree : Tree ℝ) :
    (scale c tree).exactSum = c * tree.exactSum := by
  induction tree with
  | leaf value => rfl
  | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
      simp only [scale, exactSum_node, ihLeft, ihRight]
      ring

end Tree
end Research.BinaryTreeReduction
import Research.Common.FloatingPoint.Gamma
import Research.Projects.BinaryTreeReduction.Algorithm

/-! # Floating-point binary-tree reduction -/

namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction

open Research.FloatingPoint

/-- Evaluate a tree using floating-point addition at every internal node. -/
def roundedSum (model : Model) : Tree ℝ → ℝ
  | .leaf value => value
  | .node left right => model.add (roundedSum model left) (roundedSum model right)

/-- `perturbed` has the same shape as `original`, and each perturbed leaf
differs from its original value by at most `bound * |value|`. -/
inductive IsPerturbation (bound : ℝ) : Tree ℝ → Tree ℝ → Prop where
  | leaf (x y : ℝ) (error_le : |y - x| ≤ bound * |x|) :
      IsPerturbation bound (.leaf x) (.leaf y)
  | node {left left' right right' : Tree ℝ}
      (left_ok : IsPerturbation bound left left')
      (right_ok : IsPerturbation bound right right') :
      IsPerturbation bound (.node left right) (.node left' right')

namespace IsPerturbation

/-- A leafwise perturbation remains valid when its nonnegative bound grows. -/
theorem mono {original perturbed : Tree ℝ} {bound nextBound : ℝ}
    (h : IsPerturbation bound original perturbed)
    (hbound : bound ≤ nextBound) :
    IsPerturbation nextBound original perturbed := by
  induction h with
  | leaf x y error_le =>
      apply IsPerturbation.leaf
      exact error_le.trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (abs_nonneg x))
  | node left_ok right_ok ihLeft ihRight =>
      exact IsPerturbation.node ihLeft ihRight

/-- Compose two leafwise relative perturbations. -/
theorem trans {original middle perturbed : Tree ℝ} {first second : ℝ}
    (hFirst : IsPerturbation first original middle)
    (hSecond : IsPerturbation second middle perturbed)
    (hsecond_nonneg : 0 ≤ second) :
    IsPerturbation (first + second * (1 + first)) original perturbed := by
  induction hFirst generalizing perturbed with
  | leaf x y first_error =>
      cases hSecond with
      | leaf _ z second_error =>
          apply IsPerturbation.leaf
          have hy : |y| ≤ (1 + first) * |x| := by
            calc
              |y| = |(y - x) + x| := by ring_nf
              _ ≤ |y - x| + |x| := abs_add_le _ _
              _ ≤ first * |x| + |x| := add_le_add first_error le_rfl
              _ = (1 + first) * |x| := by ring
          calc
            |z - x| = |(z - y) + (y - x)| := by
              congr 1
              ring
            _ ≤ |z - y| + |y - x| := abs_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ second * |y| + first * |x| :=
              add_le_add second_error first_error
            _ ≤ second * ((1 + first) * |x|) + first * |x| := by
              gcongr
            _ = (first + second * (1 + first)) * |x| := by ring
  | node left_ok right_ok ihLeft ihRight =>
      cases hSecond with
      | node secondLeft secondRight =>
          exact IsPerturbation.node
            (ihLeft secondLeft) (ihRight secondRight)

/-- Multiplying every perturbed leaf by one more relative-error factor
updates the leafwise error bound by `bound + u * (1 + bound)`. -/
theorem scale_one_add {original perturbed : Tree ℝ} {bound nextBound u δ : ℝ}
    (h : IsPerturbation bound original perturbed)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ u)
    (hnext : bound + u * (1 + bound) ≤ nextBound) :
    IsPerturbation nextBound original (Tree.scale (1 + δ) perturbed) := by
  induction h with
  | leaf x y error_le =>
      apply IsPerturbation.leaf
      have hy : |y| ≤ (1 + bound) * |x| := by
        calc
          |y| = |(y - x) + x| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |y - x| + |x| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ bound * |x| + |x| := add_le_add error_le le_rfl
          _ = (1 + bound) * |x| := by ring
      calc
        |(1 + δ) * y - x| = |(y - x) + δ * y| := by
          congr 1
          ring
        _ ≤ |y - x| + |δ * y| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |y - x| + |δ| * |y| := by rw [abs_mul]
        _ ≤ bound * |x| + u * ((1 + bound) * |x|) := by
          gcongr
        _ = (bound + u * (1 + bound)) * |x| := by ring
        _ ≤ nextBound * |x| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnext (abs_nonneg x)
  | node left_ok right_ok ihLeft ihRight =>
      exact IsPerturbation.node ihLeft ihRight

end IsPerturbation

/-- A tree whose depth is at most `k` evaluates in floating point as the exact
sum of leaf values perturbed by at most `gamma k u`.

The model's specification incorporates the assumption that every operation
under consideration avoids overflow and underflow.
-/
theorem roundedSum_exists_perturbation_of_depth_le
    (model : Model) (k : ℕ) (tree : Tree ℝ)
    (hdepth : tree.depth ≤ k)
    (hsmall : (k : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
      IsPerturbation (gamma k model.u) tree perturbed ∧
      perturbed.exactSum = roundedSum model tree := by
  induction k generalizing tree with
  | zero =>
      cases tree with
      | leaf x =>
          refine ⟨.leaf x, ?_, rfl⟩
          apply IsPerturbation.leaf
          simp
      | node left right =>
          simp [Tree.depth] at hdepth
  | succ k ih =>
      cases tree with
      | leaf x =>
          refine ⟨.leaf x, ?_, rfl⟩
          apply IsPerturbation.leaf
          have hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma (k + 1) model.u :=
            gamma_nonneg (k + 1) model.u model.u_nonneg (by
              norm_num at hsmall ⊢
              exact hsmall)
          simpa using mul_nonneg hgamma (abs_nonneg x)
      | node left right =>
          have hleft_depth : left.depth ≤ k := by
            simp only [Tree.depth] at hdepth
            omega
          have hright_depth : right.depth ≤ k := by
            simp only [Tree.depth] at hdepth
            omega
          have htail_small : (k : ℝ) * model.u < 1 := by
            norm_num at hsmall ⊢
            nlinarith [model.u_nonneg]
          obtain ⟨left', left_ok, left_sum⟩ := ih left hleft_depth htail_small
          obtain ⟨right', right_ok, right_sum⟩ := ih right hright_depth htail_small
          obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hround⟩ :=
            model.round_spec (roundedSum model left + roundedSum model right)
          let scaledLeft := Tree.scale (1 + δ) left'
          let scaledRight := Tree.scale (1 + δ) right'
          refine ⟨Tree.node scaledLeft scaledRight, ?_, ?_⟩
          · apply IsPerturbation.node
            · exact left_ok.scale_one_add
                model.u_nonneg hδ
                (gamma_step k model.u model.u_nonneg (by
                  norm_num at hsmall ⊢
                  exact hsmall))
            · exact right_ok.scale_one_add
                model.u_nonneg hδ
                (gamma_step k model.u model.u_nonneg (by
                  norm_num at hsmall ⊢
                  exact hsmall))
          · simp only [scaledLeft, scaledRight, Tree.exactSum_node,
              Tree.exactSum_scale]
            rw [left_sum, right_sum]
            simp only [roundedSum, Model.add]
            rw [hround]
            ring

/-- Backward-error theorem specialized to the actual depth of a tree. -/
theorem roundedSum_exists_perturbation
    (model : Model) (tree : Tree ℝ)
    (hsmall : (tree.depth : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
      IsPerturbation (gamma tree.depth model.u) tree perturbed ∧
      perturbed.exactSum = roundedSum model tree :=
  roundedSum_exists_perturbation_of_depth_le model tree.depth tree le_rfl hsmall

/-- Algorithm 1 specialized backward-error theorem for every nonempty input
list. The constructed tree preserves the inputs, has logarithmic depth, and
its rounded result is the exact sum of leafwise-perturbed inputs. -/
theorem algorithm1_exists_perturbation
    (model : Model) (inputs : List ℝ) (hinputs : inputs ≠ [])
    (hsmall : (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    ∃ tree perturbed : Tree ℝ,
      reductionTree inputs = some tree ∧
      tree.leafMultiset = inputs ∧
      tree.depth ≤ Nat.clog 2 inputs.length ∧
      IsPerturbation (gamma (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) model.u) tree perturbed ∧
      perturbed.exactSum = roundedSum model tree := by
  obtain ⟨tree, htree, hleaves, hdepth⟩ := reductionTree_spec hinputs
  obtain ⟨perturbed, hperturbed, hsum⟩ :=
    roundedSum_exists_perturbation_of_depth_le model
      (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) tree hdepth hsmall
  exact ⟨tree, perturbed, htree, hleaves, hdepth, hperturbed, hsum⟩

end Research.BinaryTreeReduction
import Research.Projects.BinaryTreeReduction.Tree

/-! # Algorithm 1: offset-paired parallel binary-tree reduction -/

namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction

/-- Pair corresponding trees from two halves. If the left half has an
unmatched final tree, carry it forward unchanged. -/
def combineHalves : List (Tree α) → List (Tree α) → List (Tree α)
  | left, [] => left
  | [], right => right
  | left :: lefts, right :: rights =>
      .node left right :: combineHalves lefts rights

/-- One level of Algorithm 1. The split point is `⌈n/2⌉ = (n+1)/2`, so
the first active partial sum is paired with the first partial sum in the
second half. -/
def reductionRound (forest : List (Tree α)) : List (Tree α) :=
  let half := (forest.length + 1) / 2
  combineHalves (forest.take half) (forest.drop half)

/-- Record the initial forest and then `rounds` successive reduction levels. -/
def reductionLevelsFromForest : ℕ → List (Tree α) → List (List (Tree α))
  | 0, forest => [forest]
  | rounds + 1, forest =>
      forest :: reductionLevelsFromForest rounds (reductionRound forest)

/-- Apply exactly `rounds` levels of Algorithm 1. -/
def runRounds : ℕ → List (Tree α) → List (Tree α)
  | 0, forest => forest
  | rounds + 1, forest => runRounds rounds (reductionRound forest)

/-- Algorithm 1 levels for a list of inputs. -/
def reductionLevels (inputs : List α) : List (List (Tree α)) :=
  reductionLevelsFromForest (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) (inputs.map .leaf)

/-- Read the exact partial sums at every recorded level. -/
def exactLevelValues (levels : List (List (Tree ℝ))) : List (List ℝ) :=
  levels.map fun forest => forest.map Tree.exactSum

/-- The numerical length recurrence induced by one reduction round. -/
def roundLengthAfter : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  | 0, n => n
  | rounds + 1, n => roundLengthAfter rounds ((n + 1) / 2)

/-- All leaves in a tree, with multiplicity but without imposing an order. -/
def Tree.leafMultiset : Tree α → Multiset α
  | .leaf value => {value}
  | .node left right => left.leafMultiset + right.leafMultiset

theorem Tree.exactSum_eq_leafMultiset_sum (tree : Tree ℝ) :
    tree.exactSum = tree.leafMultiset.sum := by
  induction tree with
  | leaf value => simp [Tree.exactSum, Tree.leafMultiset]
  | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
      simp [Tree.exactSum, Tree.leafMultiset, ihLeft, ihRight]

/-- All leaves in a forest, counted with multiplicity. -/
def forestLeafMultiset (forest : List (Tree α)) : Multiset α :=
  (forest.map Tree.leafMultiset).sum

@[simp] theorem combineHalves_length (left right : List (Tree α)) :
    (combineHalves left right).length = max left.length right.length := by
  induction left generalizing right with
  | nil => cases right <;> simp [combineHalves]
  | cons tree trees ih =>
      cases right with
      | nil => simp [combineHalves]
      | cons other others => simp [combineHalves, ih, Nat.succ_max_succ]

theorem reductionRound_length (forest : List (Tree α)) :
    (reductionRound forest).length = (forest.length + 1) / 2 := by
  simp only [reductionRound, combineHalves_length, List.length_take,
    List.length_drop]
  omega

theorem reductionRound_nonempty {forest : List (Tree α)}
    (h : forest ≠ []) : reductionRound forest ≠ [] := by
  cases forest with
  | nil => exact (h rfl).elim
  | cons tree trees =>
      intro hempty
      have hlength := congrArg List.length hempty
      rw [reductionRound_length] at hlength
      simp at hlength
      omega

theorem reductionRound_shorter {forest : List (Tree α)}
    (h : 2 ≤ forest.length) :
    (reductionRound forest).length < forest.length := by
  rw [reductionRound_length]
  omega

theorem runRounds_length (rounds : ℕ) (forest : List (Tree α)) :
    (runRounds rounds forest).length = roundLengthAfter rounds forest.length := by
  induction rounds generalizing forest with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ rounds ih =>
      simp only [runRounds, roundLengthAfter, ih, reductionRound_length]

/-- Repeated ceiling-halving of a positive number reaches one after its
base-two ceiling logarithm number of rounds. -/
theorem roundLengthAfter_clog_two (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    roundLengthAfter (Nat.clog 2 n) n = 1 := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
      by_cases hn_one : n ≤ 1
      · have hn_eq : n = 1 := by omega
        subst n
        simp [roundLengthAfter]
      · have hn_two : 2 ≤ n := by omega
        let next := (n + 1) / 2
        have hnext_pos : 0 < next := by
          dsimp [next]
          omega
        have hnext_lt : next < n := by
          dsimp [next]
          omega
        have hclog : Nat.clog 2 n = Nat.clog 2 next + 1 := by
          rw [Nat.clog_of_two_le (by decide) hn_two]
          congr 2
        rw [hclog]
        simp only [roundLengthAfter]
        exact ih next hnext_lt hnext_pos

/-- The active forest after the number of rounds prescribed by Algorithm 1. -/
def finalForest (inputs : List α) : List (Tree α) :=
  runRounds (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) (inputs.map .leaf)

theorem finalForest_length {inputs : List α} (h : inputs ≠ []) :
    (finalForest inputs).length = 1 := by
  rw [finalForest, runRounds_length, List.length_map]
  apply roundLengthAfter_clog_two
  cases inputs with
  | nil => exact (h rfl).elim
  | cons value values => simp

/-- Extract the unique final tree. Empty input returns `none`. -/
def reductionTree (inputs : List α) : Option (Tree α) :=
  match finalForest inputs with
  | [tree] => some tree
  | _ => none

@[simp] theorem forestLeafMultiset_append
    (left right : List (Tree α)) :
    forestLeafMultiset (left ++ right) =
      forestLeafMultiset left + forestLeafMultiset right := by
  simp [forestLeafMultiset]

theorem forestLeafMultiset_combineHalves
    (left right : List (Tree α)) :
    forestLeafMultiset (combineHalves left right) =
      forestLeafMultiset left + forestLeafMultiset right := by
  induction left generalizing right with
  | nil => cases right <;> simp [combineHalves, forestLeafMultiset]
  | cons tree trees ih =>
      cases right with
      | nil => simp [combineHalves, forestLeafMultiset]
      | cons other others =>
          simp only [combineHalves, forestLeafMultiset, List.map_cons,
            List.sum_cons, Tree.leafMultiset]
          have hih := ih others
          unfold forestLeafMultiset at hih
          rw [hih]
          simp only [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm]

/-- A reduction round neither loses nor duplicates an input leaf. -/
theorem forestLeafMultiset_reductionRound (forest : List (Tree α)) :
    forestLeafMultiset (reductionRound forest) = forestLeafMultiset forest := by
  rw [reductionRound]
  rw [forestLeafMultiset_combineHalves]
  rw [← forestLeafMultiset_append]
  rw [List.take_append_drop]

theorem forestLeafMultiset_runRounds (rounds : ℕ)
    (forest : List (Tree α)) :
    forestLeafMultiset (runRounds rounds forest) =
      forestLeafMultiset forest := by
  induction rounds generalizing forest with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ rounds ih =>
      simp only [runRounds]
      rw [ih, forestLeafMultiset_reductionRound]

/-- Every input appears once in the initial leaf forest. -/
@[simp] theorem forestLeafMultiset_map_leaf (inputs : List α) :
    forestLeafMultiset (inputs.map Tree.leaf) = inputs := by
  induction inputs with
  | nil => simp [forestLeafMultiset]
  | cons value values ih =>
      change {value} + forestLeafMultiset (values.map Tree.leaf) =
        (value :: values : Multiset α)
      rw [ih]
      rfl

/-- Every tree in a forest has depth at most `bound`. -/
def ForestDepthLE (bound : ℕ) (forest : List (Tree α)) : Prop :=
  ∀ tree ∈ forest, tree.depth ≤ bound

theorem combineHalves_depth_le {left right : List (Tree α)} {bound : ℕ}
    (hleft : ForestDepthLE bound left)
    (hright : ForestDepthLE bound right) :
    ForestDepthLE (bound + 1) (combineHalves left right) := by
  induction left generalizing right with
  | nil =>
      cases right with
      | nil => simp [ForestDepthLE, combineHalves]
      | cons tree trees =>
          intro candidate hcandidate
          exact (hright candidate (by simpa [combineHalves] using hcandidate)).trans
            (Nat.le_succ bound)
  | cons tree trees ih =>
      cases right with
      | nil =>
          intro candidate hcandidate
          exact (hleft candidate (by simpa [combineHalves] using hcandidate)).trans
            (Nat.le_succ bound)
      | cons other others =>
          have htree : tree.depth ≤ bound := hleft tree (by simp)
          have hother : other.depth ≤ bound := hright other (by simp)
          have htrees : ForestDepthLE bound trees := by
            intro candidate hcandidate
            exact hleft candidate (by simp [hcandidate])
          have hothers : ForestDepthLE bound others := by
            intro candidate hcandidate
            exact hright candidate (by simp [hcandidate])
          intro candidate hcandidate
          simp only [combineHalves, List.mem_cons] at hcandidate
          rcases hcandidate with rfl | hcandidate
          · simp only [Tree.depth]
            omega
          · exact ih htrees hothers candidate hcandidate

theorem reductionRound_depth_le {forest : List (Tree α)} {bound : ℕ}
    (hdepth : ForestDepthLE bound forest) :
    ForestDepthLE (bound + 1) (reductionRound forest) := by
  apply combineHalves_depth_le
  · intro tree htree
    exact hdepth tree (List.mem_of_mem_take htree)
  · intro tree htree
    exact hdepth tree (List.mem_of_mem_drop htree)

theorem runRounds_depth_le {forest : List (Tree α)} {bound : ℕ}
    (hdepth : ForestDepthLE bound forest) (rounds : ℕ) :
    ForestDepthLE (bound + rounds) (runRounds rounds forest) := by
  induction rounds generalizing forest bound with
  | zero => simpa [runRounds] using hdepth
  | succ rounds ih =>
      simp only [runRounds]
      have hround := reductionRound_depth_le hdepth
      have hresult := ih hround
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hresult

theorem finalForest_preserves_inputs (inputs : List α) :
    forestLeafMultiset (finalForest inputs) = inputs := by
  simp [finalForest, forestLeafMultiset_runRounds]

theorem finalForest_depth_le (inputs : List α) :
    ForestDepthLE (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) (finalForest inputs) := by
  unfold finalForest
  have hinitial : ForestDepthLE 0 (inputs.map Tree.leaf) := by
    intro tree htree
    simp only [List.mem_map] at htree
    obtain ⟨value, _, rfl⟩ := htree
    simp
  simpa using runRounds_depth_le hinitial (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length)

/-- Algorithm 1 returns one tree for every nonempty input. That tree contains
exactly the input multiset and has depth at most `Nat.clog 2 inputs.length`. -/
theorem reductionTree_spec {inputs : List α} (hinputs : inputs ≠ []) :
    ∃ tree : Tree α,
      reductionTree inputs = some tree ∧
      tree.leafMultiset = inputs ∧
      tree.depth ≤ Nat.clog 2 inputs.length := by
  have hlength := finalForest_length hinputs
  have hpreserve := finalForest_preserves_inputs inputs
  have hdepth := finalForest_depth_le inputs
  cases hforest : finalForest inputs with
  | nil => simp [hforest] at hlength
  | cons tree trees =>
      cases trees with
      | nil =>
          refine ⟨tree, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [reductionTree, hforest]
          · simpa [hforest, forestLeafMultiset] using hpreserve
          · exact hdepth tree (by simp [hforest])
      | cons other others => simp [hforest] at hlength

/-- For real inputs, the tree returned by Algorithm 1 has exactly the same
real-valued sum as the input list. -/
theorem reductionTree_exactSum {inputs : List ℝ} {tree : Tree ℝ}
    (htree : reductionTree inputs = some tree) :
    tree.exactSum = inputs.sum := by
  by_cases hinputs : inputs = []
  · subst inputs
    simp [reductionTree, finalForest, runRounds] at htree
  · obtain ⟨result, hresult, hleaves, _⟩ := reductionTree_spec hinputs
    rw [hresult] at htree
    cases htree
    rw [Tree.exactSum_eq_leafMultiset_sum, hleaves]
    simp

end Research.BinaryTreeReduction
